text: Understanding databases is essential for modern software development. There are two main types: SQL and NoSQL. SQL databases store data in tables with rows and columns, which makes them ideal for structured information. NoSQL databases are more flexible and work well with unstructured data. To retrieve information, developers write queries, which are special commands that ask the database for specific data. Data modeling is the process of planning how data is organized and connected before building the system. Finally, indexes help databases find information quickly, just like an index in a book. Good indexes make queries much faster, especially when working with large amounts of data.
